incomingScope: Six production services and four regression files: retained Authoring-to-Vault receipt, eCTD governance derivation and unambiguous Vault check-in hints. No source overlap with device identity/actions changes.
findings: New filing receipts record the existing saved authoring version and section digest. The export log reuses that same digest; no product family, filing type, approval or transport decision is derived from it.

Receipt lookup scopes tenant and exact Vault UUID, verifies source/project/artifact/payload and canonical chain/seal status, and preserves not-recorded/unverified/unavailable/no-key distinctions. It reads retained records rather than current editable text.

Vault leaf staging retains native UUID, organization scope, provider byte/hash/PDF checks and the existing approval/current-version transmit gate. Added derivation uses the actual Vault source program and remains separate from alias identity and approval.
Governance manifest distinguishes retained-input artifact SHA-256 from normalized shipped leaf bytes; no receipt claims the shipped leaf hash or authorizes transmission.
Current-version conflict hints require exactly one scoped live head; an ambiguous chain provides no guessed head. This does not widen allowed device subtype or market actions.
Device/CDx/SaMD intake validation, known-device added-market refusals and exact regional preparation-only UI remain unchanged in the merged tree.
Human guide keeps incoming cases 59–61 and device cases 62–67, with 67 unique sequential case IDs, both continuation links and no conflict markers.
